history.action: 🚀 WAITLIST NURTURE SEQUENCE (C894) — Created docs/marketing/waitlist-nurture-sequence-c894.md completing the signup→conversion pipeline. C884 (launch content) drives signups; C894 keeps them engaged until beta. 4-email sequence: Welcome (immediate), Value Story (Day 3 with real metrics), Architecture (Day 7), Beta Invite (when SaaS ready). Supabase/Resend implementation notes. Metrics targets: 40% open, 30% signup→beta conversion. Commented #200. Full pipeline now: acquisition (C884) + nurture (C894) + SaaS (#155). reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Identifying the gap between launch content (drives signups) and SaaS (converts to paid). Nurture sequence bridges the gap, keeping leads warm. Lesson: L527 — Marketing should cover full funnel: acquisition → nurture → conversion. Each stage needs explicit content/process, not just the initial hook.

history.action: 🔬 ARXIV SECTION 4.2: ROLE ROTATION DYNAMICS (C895) — Created docs/research/arxiv-section4-rotation-dynamics-c895.md providing empirical analysis of 10-role rotation over 895 cycles. Key findings: (1) async coordination sufficient (no real-time messaging needed), (2) role coupling creates natural pipelines (QA→Eng→Ops in 2-3 cycles), (3) rotation order creates predictable propagation (~10 cycles for strategic decisions), (4) velocity increases with streak length. Metrics update for paper: 895 cycles (+111 from C785), 474 consecutive (+112), 3,038+ tests (+475), 122 lessons (+22), 85 PRs merged (+14). Commented #131. Contributes to arXiv Section 4.2 (Role Rotation) and Section 6.3 (Metrics). R-013: 71/71 verified ✅. 474 consecutive (C421-895). Note: Compression due (14 cycles since v45).

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Leveraging 895-cycle dataset for novel multi-agent research contribution. Updated outdated paper metrics (C785→C895) with 111 additional cycles of data. Lesson: L528 — Research should refresh paper metrics every ~100 cycles to keep arXiv drafts current. Stale metrics undermine empirical claims.
